description: An object literal into a cell typed by a `type X:struct` with an invariant (low 5 > mid 1): E-WRITE-INVARIANT — a cell of the type inherits its invariants.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-struct-invariant-syntax ("yes, your recommendations on all three plus the follow-up"); ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-struct-invariant-contract ("RULED yes (a)")
rationale: §66.13.5 rule 5 (a cell of an existing type INHERITS that type's invariants) and rule 9 (an object literal constructed as a value of the type is a provable case).
